question: What is the capital city of Australia?

subquestions: What is the capital city of Australia?

args.query: capital city of Australia Canberra official
capital city of Australia Canberra official

observations.content:
[1] Australia - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia
    Australia, officially the Commonwealth of Australia, is a country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania and numerous smaller islands.The Australian Capital Territory was formed in 1911 as the location for the future federal capital of Canberra.

[2] Canberra is officially Australia’s safest city | The Australian National...
    https://study.anu.edu.au/explore-anu/stories/canberra-officially-australias-safest-city
    Australia’s capital city, Canberra, is known for many things.The exterior of the Australian Parliament House in the capital city of Canberra. In Canberra, you have access to some of Australia’s most iconic and recognisable spots. We are inclusive, diverse and proud.

[3] Why Canberra is the Capital of Australia | Remitly
    https://www.remitly.com/blog/en-au/lifestyle-culture/capital-of-australia/
    Canberra is the official capital. It was chosen in 1908, founded in 1913, and officially became the working capital in 1927 when Parliament moved from Melbourne. Why isn’t Sydney the capital of Australia? Sydney and Melbourne both wanted the title after Federation.

[4] Whats The Capital of Australia | TikTok
    https://www.tiktok.com/discover/whats-the-capital-of-australia
    #Australia #capitalcity #Canberra #Sydney #Melbourne #map #geography #mapper Discovering the Capital City of Australia: Canberra. Uncover the facts about Australia's capital city, Canberra. Learn about its significance in geography.

[5] Where is Canberra | Canberra
    https://canberra.com.au/other/where-is-canberra
    Canberra is Australia’s capital city. A place of new ideas and social change, of community and connection. You’ll find us in south east Australia, in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT).

steps.note: The capital city of Australia is **Canberra**. (See sources: [S2], [S5])
